caption: The drawing features a predominantly green background with a soft, textured appearance, resembling painted or stained walls. At the top of the image, there is a horizontal band with a decorative scalloped border, colored in beige and light green, adorned with a row of evenly spaced black dots resembling a string of beads or garland. Below this border, two arched, reddish-brown lines extend downwards and outwards from the center of the top edge, forming a loose symmetrical pattern. Interwoven with these arcs are leafy green branches with dark green and some reddish-outlined leaves. At the intersection of these lines in the center, there is a circular flower-like shape with a white and gray center, from which five pointed dark green “petals” or leaves extend. Small black markings within the circle create a simple face-like pattern with two dots as eyes and a curved line as a mouth. Additional brushstrokes of reddish-brown can be seen lightly scattered across the background, adding texture and depth to the overall green field. The whole composition is enclosed within a narrow white border.
title: Free Hand Wall Decoration
